prompt: Edit this photo. Keep everything else exactly identical: the person, face, hands, clothes, lighting, colors and framing. Change only this: 1) make the yellow balloon she is placing much smaller: a small 5-inch latex balloon, about half the diameter of the coral balloons around it, pressed into the gap between the pink and coral balloons; 2) replace the white tape roll in her other hand with a small flat roll of balloon glue dots (a narrow white backing strip with small clear round adhesive dots). Change nothing else. No text anywhere.

Edit this photo. Keep everything else exactly identical: the person, face, hands, clothes, lighting, colors and framing. Keep the small balloons in the lower half, the woman, her face, her hands, the bow and the base exactly as they are. No text anywhere.

Real photograph taken handheld with a phone's main camera (26mm equivalent), natural overcast window daylight only, coming from the left; no lamps switched on, no golden glow, neutral white balance, slightly imperfect exposure with mild clipping at the window, subtle sensor grain, slightly off-center casual framing. True skin texture with visible pores, faint under-eye shadow, flyaway hairs, natural asymmetry; no retouching, no beauty filter. Balloon colors vivid and true. Bright, clean, well-kept contemporary middle-class Latin American interior, tidy and nicely decorated (a potted plant, a framed abstract print, light wood shelves). The woman is exactly the person in the three reference photos (same face, same features, same earrings, same body). Identity (a real Colombian woman who consented to this digital double): early 30s, soft oval face with full rounded cheek apples, slightly slimmed with gently defined cheekbones and a soft clean jawline, small rounded chin. Large dark-brown almond eyes, rounder than average, visible upper crease, full dark lashes, faint under-eye shadow. Thick dark eyebrows, fairly straight with a low soft arch, set close to the eyes. Nose: short from the front with a soft, wide rounded tip and broad nostrils; in profile a low straight bridge, a fleshy rounded tip that turns up slightly, short columella. Medium-full lips, clear cupid's bow, fuller lower lip; open smile shows the upper teeth with very little gum, even natural white teeth of normal size, NO braces; the closed smile tucks the corners into small cheek creases. Smooth rounded hairline, side part, long straight jet-black hair past the chest with face-framing front layers. Light warm-olive beige skin (not bronze), natural texture, only a few faint small moles, almost no freckles. Natural proportions as in the real photos, slightly slimmer. Her long straight jet-black hair is gathered in a low ponytail resting over one shoulder, with the face-framing front strands loose. Plain white t-shirt under a deep navy-indigo bib apron with raspberry-coral neck strap and ties, no logo or print. Her face is turned three-quarters toward the camera, both eyes visible and her features clearly recognizable, while her eyes look down at her work with a relaxed, pleasant half-smile. Waist-up, she stands at a white worktable holding up a just-inflated crystal-clear 24-inch bubble balloon in front of her chest, a little to her side so it does not hide her face. The bubble is round, taut and smooth, clean transparent plastic with soft highlights and nothing reflected in it, and inside it are seven small 5-inch latex balloons in fuchsia, turquoise, yellow, orange and chrome gold resting at the bottom. With her right hand she pinches the bubble's short narrow neck closed between thumb and index finger, the neck pointing down; her left hand supports the bubble from below on the other side, open palm. On the table, not touching her hands: a compact electric balloon inflator (a small smooth white box with two short conical nozzles on top, no label), a white bowl with more small inflated balloons, a small dish of metallic confetti and one ribbon spool. Neither arm passes behind or inside the bubble. Exactly two hands in the picture, both hers, each with five natural fingers, the two hands clearly apart from each other; short clean natural nails, no rings, no bracelets. Wide 16:9 composition with the face, hands and main piece in the central two thirds of the frame. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, signs or screens anywhere; every tool, machine, spool, box and bag is completely plain with no label, sticker or print. No balloon debris on the floor. Latex balloons are round, never pear-shaped, with small tight knots hidden from view. Rich mix of balloon types and vivid colors: matte latex in saturated fuchsia, coral, orange, sunny yellow, turquoise and lilac, several chrome metallic latex balloons (gold, rose gold, silver, metallic blue), and where it fits a smooth, fully inflated foil star or heart and a clear balloon with confetti inside. Abundant, finished, professional-looking work.
